provenance: shape and seed cases adapted from addy-osmani-agent-skills/evals (skill-creator evals.json schema + kind); merged-skill expectations added

evals.prompt: I want 'a better admin page'. Interview me before proposing anything.
evals.expected_output: A one-question-at-a-time interview through brain:ask-user-question that converges on a confirmed intent with an Out of scope line
expectations: The first act is the Skill call for brain:ask-user-question, before any question
An explicit hypothesis with a confidence number is stated before the first question
Questions are asked one at a time, never in batches, each with the agent's recommended answer attached
The agent does not propose solutions before the restate is confirmed
The restate carries Outcome / User / Why now / Success / Constraint / Out of scope and waits for an explicit yes

evals.prompt: Here is my migration plan — grill it until we both trust it.
evals.expected_output: The plan mapped as a design tree, its frontier worked one question at a time in dependency order, facts fetched by subagents, done only when nothing is silently assumed
expectations: The plan is interrogated as a design tree with a frontier, not a flat list of questions
Questions go one at a time through brain:ask-user-question with a recommendation attached; no round asks two at once
A question whose prerequisite is unsettled is deferred, not asked
Environment facts are fetched by the agent, never asked of the user
The session ends with explicit confirmation of shared understanding, and a Not-yet-specified list where fog remains
